headline: WORLD'S OLDEST SHIPWRECK FOUND IN TURKEY?
display: And archaeologists say it may be the oldest shipwreck ever found.
It lies off Kekova Island, in southern Turkey… 30 meters down.
More than 30 clay jars, and three stone anchors, still resting where the ship went down.
It sank around the time the Great Pyramid was being built.
Some of the jars may still hold traces of their cargo. Scientists are testing them now.
So what was this ship carrying… when it sank, 4,700 years ago?
